children: Sweden IT reseller's Q4 revenue fell 4.8%, missing analyst expectations
Adjusted EBITA for Q4 beat analyst estimates despite lower sales
Company says Q4 sales decline due to order timing and subdued demand from higher prices
Company did not provide specific financial guidance for the coming quarters or year
ORDER TIMING - Co said Q4 sales declined partly because orders were brought forward to the previous quarter
SUBDUED DEMAND - Co said demand was subdued in Q4 due to higher price levels
EFFICIENCY MEASURES - Co said profitability improved mainly due to a lower cost base after efficiency measures, per CEO Samuel Skott
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "hold" and the breakdown of recommendations is 1 "strong buy" or "buy", 3 "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the computer hardware peer group is "buy."
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Dustin Group AB is SEK2.03, about 14.5% above its October 13 closing price of SEK1.77
The stock recently traded at 8 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 7 three months ago
